scope: Focused local synthetic migration measurements; not a production capacity or complete migration replay benchmark
schema_fixture_limitations: Relevant column/index definitions preserved where measured; engagement/scan rows use a 256-byte synthetic payload, not complete historical schemas.
ticket_intents uses its complete foundation column/check/index definition and minimal FK parent fixtures; no application triggers, other than migration 0251 trigger.
All million ticket intents are done/create/nonempty remote ID: maximum qualifying backfill/index population for N.
RLS enable procedure is a fixture using ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and a simple tenant policy; execution is migration-owner superuser, not runtime role.
Docker local storage, one sample per migration; warm local cache; no production I/O, replicas, concurrent live traffic or table bloat.

One synthetic tenant and integration, 1000 mapping/engagement grouping keys; synthetic text IDs are shorter than production opaque IDs and can reduce index bytes. Engagement assessment_project_id repeats across 1000 values, allowing B-tree deduplication; production cardinality and width can differ.

server_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
method: Native libpq connections through isolated loopback-only Docker port; explicit transaction matching transactional Goose Up; separate monitor plus concurrent one-row read and no-op update, started after relation lock first observed. One sample for each selected migration.

sample_limits.lock_acquisition_contention: No preexisting long-running holder; contender queries start only after migration acquired its relation lock.

recommendation: Treat B07 upgrade as a maintenance-window migration: drain API/MCP and all database-writing workers, inspect/resolve long-running transactions, take the existing prescribed backup, migrate with an owner identity and bounded lock acquisition, verify migration completion and FORCE RLS before enabling matching consumers. Rehearse on a representative restored database and size the window from that measurement. Do not describe these transactional ordinary indexes/backfill as zero-downtime. Keep schema on rollback when durable B07 rows exist; use forward fixes.
